milestone: CW 0.12 · ChatGPT Plugin Acceptance & Production Readiness

decisions.production_mcp: managed public HTTPS MCP gateway and relay paired with an outbound-only user-run local CW agent
decisions.authentication: OAuth 2.1 MCP authorization with PKCE and CIMD preferred, DCR supported when required
decisions.project_authorization: explicit principal/workspace/device/project grants using opaque project handles
decisions.high_consequence: separate typed single-use ceremony; ordinary OAuth scope or conversation is insufficient
decisions.chatgpt_pro: read-only default; controlled actions require actual surface discovery
decisions.business_enterprise: workspace-admin opt-in and least-privilege scopes; no policy bypass
decisions.plugin_package: current plugin.json plus skill and local MCP; remote .app.json deferred until a real registered endpoint exists
decisions.privacy: source and .cw remain local; only normalized minimum-disclosure CW envelopes cross the relay
decisions.operations: Queopius owns gateway policy and service operations; operator owns local agent and grants
decisions.submission: BLOCKED pending implementation, public HTTPS, OAuth, domain verification, legal/business approval, and external acceptance
